title: BodyInfo
description: GET /api/v1/jois/{id}/body: the body she is in, its models and the state of their parts, and its animations.

model.description: The full model, null when none was chosen.

lookingGlassModel.description: The lighter model for the Looking Glass, null for the full one there too.

parts.description: The parts of the full model that can be switched, each in the state the body is in.

appearance.description: How she looks in it now, null when the model is not described.
